'''Marso's Demons''' was a group of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] led by [[Marso]]. [[Gallandro/Legends|Gallandro]] was once a member of the group, and was generally considered one of the best Demons ever.
